description: Move playback to a different Spotify Connect device, named by exact id, by the label you gave it, or by a case-insensitive name substring. A plain transfer restarts the track at 0:00 on the target; `preserve_position: true` carries the current track and play position across instead, and `restore_shuffle_repeat: true` re-applies the current shuffle and repeat modes on the target. Quota: 1 read to resolve the device, then 1–4 writes depending on the flags.

device.description: Target device: exact id, sidecar label, or case-insensitive name substring

dry_run.description: Preview only: describe what would change without performing it. Default false — pass true to preview.

play.description: Force play (true) or arrive paused (false); omit to preserve the current play state. With preserve_position, true also resumes a session that is currently paused.

preserve_position.description: Resume the current track at its current position on the target instead of restarting it (default: false)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

restore_shuffle_repeat.description: Re-apply the current shuffle and repeat modes on the target (default: false)

volume.description: Volume to set on the target after transfer, 0–100

name: transfer_playback
